messages:
maria: Heads-up 1 final copy pass needed for Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing pages. Put starter variants in the doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/marketing/tri_mode_copy_v2. Please review.
charlie: read it. Hosted feels vague. let's be explicit about latency stability and cost predictability.
kevin: proposed Hosted hero options: 'Fast inference API. Predictable pricing.' and 'Production-grade throughput, predictable cost.'
sasha: Dedicated should lead with reserved capacity + SLA. drafts: 'Reserved GPU capacity. SLA-backed throughput.' and 'Guaranteed throughput with burst options.'
emma: Private page needs softer gate: CTA = 'Start trial' or 'Request trial' (legal prefers trials for PoC). call out KMS integrations in a one-liner.
maria: good. please provide exactly 2 hero lines per page and 2 micro-bullets (economics + controls). I'll assemble A/B variants.
charlie: bullets examples: '- Typical cost reduction of up to 3x on cache-heavy workloads' and '- Canaries, version pinning, and rollback controls'. add short methodology link.
kevin: benchmark slide for landing: small chart + link to PDF. headline: 'Up to 3x lower token cost in cache-optimized scenarios' and tiny qualifier 'results vary by workload; see methods'. I'll deliver slide.
sasha: inbound mapping: Hosted -> self-serve trial leads; Dedicated -> SDR (tag=dedicated); Private -> AE (tag=enterprise). add hidden form field `product_mode`.
emma: webinar plan: main session 30m (serving runtime + economics), three 20m breakouts (Hosted ops, Dedicated scale, Private compliance). CTAs in emails link to mode-specific forms.
maria: UTM for all launch links: `?utm_source=launch_post&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=tri_mode_launch&utm_content={variant}&product={mode}` use exact string.
kevin: implementers: form snippet example: `<input type="hidden" name="product_mode" value="hosted">` parse and route.
charlie: FAQ microcopy to add: KMS/HSM: 'Supports customer KMS & HSM for key control.' VPC: 'Private deployments run inside customer VPCs.' SLA: 'Dedicated includes a throughput SLA and uptime commitment.' keep <=15 words.
sasha: timeline: teaser (M-10), benchmark highlight (M-4), webinar invite (M-2), final reminder (M-1), launch-day recap + CTAs (D+0).
emma: I'll draft the 3-email webinar sequence and share by Thu.
ops-bot: Copy-freeze reminder set for 2026-04-08T16:00:00Z.
maria: action items: Maria compile final variants by Tue EOD; Kevin deliver benchmark slide by Mon; Emma draft emails by Thu; Charlie add FAQ lines by Tue; Sasha finalize routing spec.
kevin: one nit 1 ensure CTA visual weight is consistent across pages even if text differs (Design please).
maria: thanks team. I'll post the final consolidated doc once variants are in. :rocket:
